Speculative. Reported secondhand by online sources such as Semianalysis, but not verified by OpenAI. If total number of tokens seen was 13T, text was repeated for 2 epochs, and text was the majority of tokens, then dataset size roughly is 13T*0.75/2 = 4.9T words.

Note this examines only the text dataset, since GPT-4 was first and foremost a language model. However, the vision component had its own vision dataset, which we believe accounted for a much smaller part of the compute budget.
